newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar sets new 31-month high against mark.
newsitem.headline: Dollar sets new 31-month high against mark.

text.p: The dollar hit a fresh 31-month high against the mark in late afternoon Tokyo trade on Tuesday, dealers said.
It first hit 1.6557 marks, then rose even higher to around 1.6560 marks, pulled up by its gains against the yen, against which it set a new 47-month high of 120.35 yen a short time earlier.
Dealers said some stop-loss buying orders were triggered near 1.6520-50 marks, helping the greenback to climb.
